<!-- pr-reviewer: 078564142fecbcac689b7dc8e3bbb78c8c42bcf5 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Good results:
- The two tests use the current Bore ring plan. They check the stored hole data and the messages for holes that the plan cannot clear.
- The mixed fixture keeps the wide through hole and names the blind hole that exceeds the ring limit.
- The second fixture checks that a refused detection stores no holes.
- The decision record explains why the old tests failed and why this fixture was selected.

Local checks:
The trial merge with upstream/main `6f8b309dcea9ea2c367ecfa53261ed140881bab3` had no conflicts. All builds and tests ran on this machine, in the review worktree. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | Passed |
| `detect_holes_note_tests::detect_holes_on_a_bore_op_stores_the_wide_through_hole_and_names_the_one_past_the_ring_budget` | 1 passed |
| `detect_holes_note_tests::detect_holes_on_a_bore_op_with_only_a_hole_past_the_ring_budget_is_refused` | 1 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui` | 815 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| `git diff --check upstream/main` | Passed |

The quick gate plan also completed. Its merge-base calculation included changes from main in the uncommitted trial merge. The actual checks used the UI scope shown above.

Requested changes: none.

Notes:
- This PR changes tests and a decision record only. It does not change posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or product geometry code. No mutation tests were required or run. No golden files changed.
- No visible UI changes. Before and after screenshots are not required for this test change.
- The PR author is NeoTech. The draft state stays unchanged; the author must mark the PR ready.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
